Here is the assessment.

## Two config files reviewed

1. **`vitest.config.ts`** — main test runner config
2. **`vitest.benchmark.config.mts`** — benchmark runner config

Both import `defineConfig` from `vitest/config` and share the same alias block. The repo pins `"vitest": "^2.1.4"` (in `package.json`). The upstream docs I checked are for **vitest v5.0.0** (the current stable at `vitest.dev`).

---

## Finding 1 — `server.deps.external` is deprecated

Both files use this:

| File | Line(s) |
|---|---|
| `vitest.config.ts` | 46–49 (`test.server.deps.external: ["node:sqlite"]`) |
| `vitest.benchmark.config.mts` | 35 (`server: { deps: { external: ["node:sqlite"] } }`) |

The upstream doc page [vitest.dev/config/server](https://vitest.dev/config/server) is titled **"# server deprecated"** and states:

> Before Vitest 4, this option was used to define the configuration for the `vite-node` server. [...] **WARNING: These options should be used only as the last resort** to improve performance by externalizing auto-inlined dependencies or to fix issues by inlining invalid external dependencies. **Normally, Vitest should do this automatically.**

The `server` section was deprecated as of **Vitest 4**. Since this repo is on `^2.1.4`, it is valid *for that version* but would trigger deprecation warnings on any upgrade to v4+. No direct replacement is documented — the docs simply say Vitest handles this automatically now.

---

## All other options — no issues found

| Option | File(s) | Upstream status |
|---|---|---|
| `resolve.alias` | Both (top-level, not under `test`) | **Current** — standard Vite option ([vite.dev/config/shared-options](https://vite.dev/config/shared-options)) |
| `ssr.external` | Both (top-level, not under `test`) | **Current** — standard Vite option ([vite.dev/config/ssr-options](https://vite.dev/config/ssr-options)) |
| `test.environment` | Both | **Current** — [vitest.dev/config/environment](https://vitest.dev/config/environment) |
| `test.include` | Both | **Current** — [vitest.dev/config/include](https://vitest.dev/config/include) |
| `test.testTimeout` | Both | **Current** — [vitest.dev/config/testtimeout](https://vitest.dev/config/testtimeout) |
| `test.hookTimeout` | benchmark config only | **Current** — [vitest.dev/config/hooktimeout](https://vitest.dev/config/hooktimeout) |

---

## Summary

**One finding:** `server.deps.external` (used in both `vitest.config.ts:46` and `vitest.benchmark.config.mts:35`) is deprecated as of Vitest 4. The repo is on `^2.1.4`, so it works today but will be deprecated if upgraded. The upstream docs say Vitest now handles `node:sqlite` externalization automatically, so the `server` block may be removable on upgrade. Everything else is current.
